# 1 Enoch Chapter 22 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**22:1** And from there I went to another place, and he showed me in the west a great and high mountain with a hard rock and four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth. Three of them were dark and one was bright, with a spring of water in its midst. And I said: "How smooth these hollow places are, and how deep and dark they appear!"

**22:2** Then Raphael, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said to me: "These hollow places have been created for this very purpose — that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble in them, yes, that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here."

**22:3** "And these places have been made to receive them until the day of their judgment and until their appointed period, until the great judgment comes upon them."

**22:4** I saw the spirit of a dead man, and his voice went forth to heaven and made supplication.

**22:5** And I asked Raphael, the angel who was with me, and said to him: "This spirit — whose is it, whose voice goes forth and makes supplication to heaven?"

**22:6** And he answered me and said: "This is the spirit that went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him until his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth and his seed is annihilated from among the seed of men."

**22:7** Then I asked regarding it and regarding all the hollow places: "Why is one separated from another?"

**22:8** And he answered me and said: "These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And this division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water."

**22:9** "And such a place has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgment has not been executed on them during their lifetime."

**22:10** "Here their spirits shall be set apart in great pain until the great day of judgment, and of punishment and torment of those who curse forever, and retribution for their spirits. There he shall bind them forever."

**22:11** "And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their own destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners."

**22:12** "And such a place has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression. But their spirits shall not be slain on the day of judgment, nor shall they be raised from there."

**22:13** Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said: "Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness, who rules forever."

**22:14** And from there I went to another place to the east of that mountain, and there I saw the ends of the earth.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). Chapter 22's fourfold Sheol is one of the most important passages in 1 Enoch for Second Temple eschatology. The four chambers are distinguished: bright chamber with spring (righteous), dark chamber for unjudged sinners, chamber for murder victims, chamber for thorough sinners not to be raised. Abel's petition (v. 6) exemplifies the third category.*
